I_ACCESS.description: Users report being unable to sign in because the app will not accept their password or let them access their account.

I_BILLING.description: Users object to features such as song selection and playback being restricted to Premium, and to content or features becoming premium-only after updates.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs, inconsistent lyrics availability, and unwanted recommendations.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report downloads getting stuck and offline listening not working.

I_OTHER.description: Users express general dissatisfaction with the app or its support and say they are uninstalling, without specifying a concrete product problem.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report playback and app reliability problems, including songs failing to start or stopping, crashes, loading issues, connectivity trouble, and controls that do not work properly.

I_USABILITY.description: Users object to changes in playback controls, queueing, navigation, and frequent ads that interrupt listening.
